Package com.worldline.acquiring.sdk.java

Class Communicator

java.lang.Object
com.worldline.acquiring.sdk.java.Communicator
All Implemented Interfaces:
LoggingCapable, ObfuscationCapable, Closeable, AutoCloseable
public class Communicator extends Object implements Closeable, LoggingCapable, ObfuscationCapable
Used to communicate with the Worldline Acquiring platform web services.

It contains all the logic to transform a request object to a HTTP request and a HTTP response to a response object.

Thread-safe.
